segments.text: Okay, I didn't know this was real. So, I
opened this flashlight and inside I
found this rechargeable AA battery, but
rechargeable via USB type-C. It has a
USBC port on it. And so, instead of one
of those clunky chargers, I mean, you
always have your phone charger drawing
you. So, boom. 1,000 mAh USB type-C
rechargeable AA battery. I'm glad this
